kinds.call_core: Mux Pane/Tab/Domain or config API. GPUI is a thin call (erase_scrollback, spawn_pane, perform_actions FullReset, config::reload, wezterm-open-url).

kinds.gpui_ui: Needs a GPUI overlay/modal. wezterm-gui uses termwiz overlays or box-model Modal.
kinds.open_url: Help OpenUri. Same crate wezterm-open-url as 034 Ctrl+click.
kinds.input_map: Key table stack. GPUI has no InputMap yet.
kinds.dynamic: Generated at runtime from mux/config. Not in PALETTE_COMMANDS until the source exists.
